billing_rules.unprotected: single slab: all units billed at the rate of the slab the monthly total falls in
billing_rules.protected: one-previous-slab benefit: first 100 units at the 1-100 rate, the rest at the 101-200 rate
billing_rules.fixed_charge: Rs per kW of sanctioned load per month, by the consumption slab

domestic_tariff.taxes_note: GST (18%), electricity duty, FPA/QTA and other levies are added on top of base charges. Roshni calibrates this factor from the user's own bill; 1.25 is used only when no bill is given.

fixed_charges_rs.unit: per kW of sanctioned load per month
